value.rationale: For the canonical nonchordal icosahedral graph, a complete 105-facet pure shelling and 20-sphere integral homotopy type provide a natural exact benchmark beyond block/trees and a meaningful structural shellability fact, not simply a numerical homology calculation. The facet and h-vectors make the result independently useful in combinatorial topology.
